description: This file defines the MajorMinorVersion struct, which represents a version with major and minor components, including methods for comparison, parsing, and string representation.

classes.name: MajorMinorVersion
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a two-component version number with major and minor parts, that supports comparison, equality, and parsing.

methods.name: MajorMinorVersion
methods.description: Constructor to initialize major and minor version components.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this version with another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another MajorMinorVersion instance or object.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on Major and Minor values.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses a string in 'major.minor' format into a MajorMinorVersion.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation in 'major.minor' format.
